metadata.description: Claude Office: Claude's work as a live pixel office in a side pane, with limit forecasts and daily cost. English (pixel-office) and Turkish (piksel-ofis).

plugins.name: pixel-office
plugins.description: English: Claude's work as a live pixel office in a side pane: limit forecast (when your 5-hour and weekly limits will fill), today's cost across chats, a context tank, auto-compact and a lively animated team.

plugins.name: piksel-ofis
plugins.description: Türkçe: Claude'un çalışmasını yan panelde canlı bir piksel ofis olarak gösterir: limit tahmini (5 saatlik ve haftalık limit ne zaman dolar), bugünün toplam maliyeti, bağlam tankı, oto-sıkıştırma ve hareketli ekip.
